headline: Stop polling me every ten minutes to see if I'm ready. Treat me like a WEBHOOK: I'll call you the second something happens.
caption:
Stop polling me every ten minutes to see if I'm ready. Treat me like a WEBHOOK: I'll call you the second something happens.

—
WEBHOOK: instead of being asked repeatedly, the server calls you when something happens.
